compatibility: Original Python schema_version=1 request is unchanged. Only fixed-node-pi-session-v1 accepts the new schema_version=2 command form. Internal session is not a model Shell target.

out_of_band_trust.configuration: Shared trusted X instance receives immutable profile/slot registries and mandatory authorization/reference resolver from trusted host constructor/configuration; peer method params cannot replace those objects.
out_of_band_trust.principal: Only trusted host route injects transport_principal; any peer body authority.transport_principal is forbidden and cannot override. Peer caller strings are correlations, never permission. Model-origin route retains runtime/task whitelist before any candidate dispatch.
out_of_band_trust.authority_reference: Untrusted method arguments may name a reference, never self-issue a grant. Resolver must compare complete context against actual registered immutable record and files. Missing checker/ref or changed registration fails closed.
out_of_band_trust.scope_limit: Same host admin/user can modify controls; this tests task/agent isolation, not malicious host administrators.
out_of_band_trust.every_operation: Each operation, including query/read/release/exact retries, resolves original full grant and complete original execution context. Having a binding or previous accepted call is not a new authorization. Query/read never mutate caller/grant/role.

dynamic_reference_records.meaning: Fixed authority root/resolver identity and rules; trusted owner may append actual future owner/restore immutable full refs with file+directory fsync. Configuration is not an impossible list of all future Engine facts.
dynamic_reference_records.scope: X expected scope comes from its own original execution registration, not owner/peer receipt. Same registration ID can never replace bytes or change association. No latest mutable pointer replaces fullref.
deny: same namespace other Session original/successor swap

snapshot_ref.meaning: Actual trusted S immutable source record including original execution/object generation or explicit empty initial snapshot; X verifies exact complete ordinary bytes/association, does not parse Pi meaning. base_version is canonical complete snapshot_ref SHA.
snapshot_ref.authority: Only configured S reference authority resolves original records; changing owner string cannot make arbitrary archive trusted.
snapshot_ref.manifest_contract: snapshot-manifest-contract.json; complete ordinary member/type/byte/hash/metadata schema plus actual empty initial archive required

source.meaning: exact registered real directory, full actual member manifest checked at activation; content must be sealed or held stable until actual RO mount. Two unsynchronized hash passes do not prove arbitrary concurrent consistency.

allowed_roles.dependencies: fixed selected manifest projection mounted /opt including Node/TSX/Pi and exact generated tsconfig
allowed_roles.input: actual F version materialized read view mounted /input
allowed_roles.workspace: actual F Workspace version materialized read view mounted /workspace

readonly_mount.content_ref: F full version_ref + actual materialized root/manifest for input/workspace; selected profile record for dependencies; trusted Harness version/F record for harness. All exact objects and hashes must agree.
reject: unregistered internal symlink or link outside source
unsupported metadata or writable source lifetime not sealed

command.entry: exact authorized /harness relative entry; actual ExecInspect ProcessConfig matches full command_argv; no Python/shell rewriting or host import
command.args: explicit finite strings covered by authority and complete invocation digest
command.environment: exact profile environment only; TSX config fixed in dependency mount; no inheritance
command.limits: exact registered profile ceilings; caller cannot override upward; smaller changes still part of immutable complete request

binding_return.meaning: actual Engine IDs verified externally; fields are associations, not proof of permission or physical truth
binding_return.digest: request_digest is the sole SHA256(canonical complete request) identity, same name as original X. No parallel request_sha256 field. Original trusted grant/slot context is separately immutable and tied to that digest; query resolves it rather than trusting peer rewrites.

requirements: One shared trusted instance reserves before any create. Reservation binds full execution request/context and role; exact duplicate resolves original reservation, changed content conflicts.
Session512/tool128/helper128 MiB and .5/.25/.25 CPU plan is fixed. Legacy Python tool request bytes unchanged; optional trusted authority context carries the slot_ref and role.
Helper capacity is reserved at slot registration and shared serially across session/tool export and observer. No fourth container; paused but unsealed objects retain reservations.
Every tmpfs, live volume, deleted-open bytes, streams, raw archive copies and host spool included in original 128MiB/8192 inode plan. Immutable RO dependencies separate/global budget.

X component, never transport alone, owns persisted pre-write reservations or bounded preallocated backing for host spool with retained originals; path moves cannot release debt. Partial failures retain reservation until actual resource stop/reclaim checked.
Slot registry/reservations are reconstructable; instance restart inspects original Engine objects before releasing or recreating. Unknown identity remains reserved; no per-wait process.
Candidate numeric reports are not evidence. Independent actual Engine/cgroup/statvfs/spool inventory confirms sums and exact own objects.
slot.actual_mount_requirement: --shm-size alone does not prove nr_inodes=64. Explicit bounded /dev/shm tmpfs options must first pass preregistered facility statvfs probe; current numeric64 remains required/unverified. /tmp/work and host spool likewise require real bytes/inode evidence. No raising totals.

bridge.scope: Trusted test transport adapter around shared X instance and original channel owner; no policy, task scheduler or model logic.

peer_envelope.meaning: Only S short-peer boundary uses this envelope. Thin shim maps to original X request_id/method/arguments; original X owns calls and receipts. No parallel state authority.

bridge.short_peers: Each JsonPort caller is a distinct short process. It forwards to one trusted Unix socket bridge and exits; transport close does not close Node stdin. Socket/credentials never mounted to Node.
bridge.call_receipt: X component itself owns original call identity/content, persisted write dispatch/outcome and stream cursors. Transport only forwards unchanged existing channel operations; it is not the only reliable journal. Exact known duplicate returns original bytes/receipt without another write; conflicting call content rejects. Lost ACK/partial write remains INCOMPLETE_OBSERVATION/UNKNOWN in original X persistent record and is never automatically re-dispatched.
bridge.close_stdin: Only explicit call on exact original channel closes; peer EOF is not close. Duplicate returns original closure state.
bridge.restart: Bridge lifetime may end with unresolved calls. A new bridge queries actual original execution and durable retained bytes; if attach/ACK continuity cannot be proved, channel stays UNKNOWN/paused and original object is explicitly stopped. It must not start another Node or replay accept/tool input.
bridge.max_live_bridge: One per shared X instance, not per Session/wait. Active channel ownership only; after all stop, no Session-specific bridge child remains.
bridge.single_control_process: The same already-validated X channel API and original durable receipts are used when called in one control process. Passing short-peer tests cannot compensate for a failure of this ordinary API.
bridge.S_legacy_compatibility: Existing S JsonPort envelope and ExecutionChannel data_b64/limit_bytes are adapted only at trusted test shim. Shim supplies explicit stable call identity and requested cursor before forwarding, records original input/return, and maps byte field names only; it does not create a second authoritative write journal or invent successful receipts.

candidate_envelope.arguments: request, authority, binding and method-specific arguments

bridge.control_encoding_bound: Node trusted-config adapter uses at most 2097152 bytes for control JSON envelope so base64 of a bounded 1MiB stream payload can be represented. The decoded payload/frame limits remain fixed at 1MiB. Original Python no-arg adapter 262144-byte control contract is unchanged.

evidence_boundary: Errors alone are never sufficient: legitimate positives actual Node/Pi; rejects observe no new own Engine object/effect and original persisted association unchanged. Missing candidate is MISSING/0, not pass.

checkpoint_retention.scope: ordinary X/S resource ownership only; no Pi interpretation. Whole execution release=stop unchanged; new artifact release requires original checkpoint grant.
checkpoint_retention.cap: at most2 live X-owned original checkpoint archives per Session execution; attempted third before release returns SLOT_EXHAUSTED with no new archive/credit leak. Input, partial output and all copies remain included in physical slot budget.
positive_preconditions: Current trusted owner authority independently resolves actual original receipt and bytes, not caller confirmed=true.

S retained_original_ref is exact old checkpoint original bytes in independently registered immutable static storage (different actual inode from still writable X source), actual hash/size, complete Session association and original request_digest all match.

Either a newer exact successor is actually confirmed by S for the same Session/generation, OR handoff_kind=sealed_ownership_transfer and X has independently confirmed the original execution/namespace fully stopped with S already owning the exact old bytes. This second resource handoff permits final/waiting Sessions to shed all X active debt without inventing a newer semantic Session. X does not infer Pi supersession; S retains exact old bytes/history.
No pending X restore/read pin needs the local old source, and original X IO handles are closed. Current unique unconfirmed/original-only snapshot cannot release.

S static artifact ownership and global20GiB/inode accounting already accepted before X deletes local old archive; same-path rename, owner-string change, hardlink alias or unregistered destination does not release debt.

X persists original full release intent before unlink. It removes only its exact original path/inode and physically confirms local resource removal before credit is returned. Crash before/after unlink reconciles same request_id/originalref; never copies/charges twice.
checkpoint_retention.history: X retains small immutable original checkpoint lineage/bytes/hash/owner receipt and released status. query_checkpoint returns released owner ref and original associations; original raw bytes remain independently readable at S authoritative original storage. No erase of checkpoint/call history.
checkpoint_retention.errors: UNAUTHORIZED wrong scope/owner; INVALID_REQUEST missing/corrupt source receipt; ID_CONFLICT changed same release ID/ref; INCOMPLETE_OBSERVATION unknown physical ownership/unlink; SLOT_EXHAUSTED attempted3rd before legitimate release.
independent_tests: Two actual X checkpoints live and same namespace; third without release physically rejected.

Existing but wrong Session/generation/old fullref receipt, merely confirmed flag, missing owner bytes, hardlink alias, unconfirmed successor, old still only original all reject and preserve X path/reservation.
Valid successor plus exact original S immutable copy permits one reclaim; original S bytes/history still queryable; new third checkpoint now fits2 and slot counts actual resources.
Repeat same release ID returns original receipt, changed reference conflicts; crash between persisted release/unlink/credit is reconciled without extra budget or source loss.

Sealed original with no newer checkpoint may fully transfer exact old bytes to confirmed S static ownership and release X debt; same path while old namespace active or owner copy missing rejects. Waiting must not retain a per-Session X execution/volume/bridge.
checkpoint_retention.owner_body_rule: Actual receipt body equals outer semantic fields excluding actual_owner_receipt_path_sha_bytes; never self-hashes. ordinary snapshot record and S ownership record are separate. Both successor fields are null only for actual sealed ownership transfer.

observable_receipts_contract: observable-receipts-contract.json; original X full artifact refs use size; S snapshot file refs use bytes. No canonical digest duplication.

checkpoint_read_boundary.hook: checkpoint_read_open_before_close after actual original archive FD opened, before read finished/FD close; another thread on same actual store attempts existing release
checkpoint_read_boundary.required: INCOMPLETE_OBSERVATION while actual read pin is held, original inode/bytes/slot unchanged; unblock and the SAME original query returns original_full_ref. No second query or synthetic pin field.
checkpoint_read_boundary.restore_scope: Node restoration reads independently confirmed S source, normally not the released X blob. This read branch proves existing restore/read retention obligation; it does not invent an X-blob dependency for S restore.
checkpoint_read_boundary.live_sealed_transfer: INCOMPLETE_OBSERVATION when original namespace remains live; valid owner bytes alone do not prove X stop.
checkpoint_read_boundary.owner_cleanup: Original object paused; stop only old validation adapter before acquiring the same original journal from direct candidate instance. After original query/release threads finish, close its actual Journal owner FD and restart original RPC owner. No duplicate store ownership.

existing_write_hook_observation.hook: Original product hook remains (label,binding). Adapter reads current original call_id via existing query_call and emits {test_barrier,binding,call_ref}; no new record/query side effect.
existing_write_hook_observation.actual_prefix: Driver reads saved original written_bytes, RO helper waits exact same actual Node received prefix; owner crash recovery must preserve prefix. Partial input131111 bytes with1MiB existing cap, ordinary send syscall requests at most65536, actual return count remains authoritative only after independent Node bytes comparison.
existing_write_hook_observation.scope: Validation hook visibility of original persisted reference only, no new public method or business state.
